title: Vector DBs Demystified: HNSW, IVF, and PQ Explained
description: Confused by HNSW, IVF, and PQ in vector databases? Learn the graph, tree, and quantization ANN algorithms, memory math, and trade-offs for production.
linkedinHook: Most vector search implementations are ticking time bombs of latency and memory usage. Here's how to disarm them before they explode your RAG pipeline.
linkedinBody: I just wrote a deep dive on vector databases, breaking down HNSW, IVF, and PQ. We cover the core algorithms, memory math, and why your pgvector setup might not scale. This is for anyone building serious RAG or similarity search. Hope it helps you build more robust systems.
